headline: During his stream last night, Drake @champagnepapi showed off his iconic Cash Money chain
body: During his stream last night, Drake @champagnepapi showed off his iconic Cash Money chain and made it clear that certain pieces carry a value that goes far beyond the price tag. When the idea of buying their “artifacts” came up, Drake drew a line between collecting jewelry and owning a piece of history: “You think you guys can buy our artifacts like how we buy your artifacts? No. It’s in the family, d-mmy.

source_caption_text:
During his stream last night, #Drake showed off his iconic Cash Money chain and made it clear that certain pieces carry a value that goes far beyond the price tag.

When the idea of buying their “artifacts” came up, Drake drew a line between collecting jewelry and owning a piece of history:

“You think you guys can buy our artifacts like how we buy your artifacts? No. It’s in the family, d-mmy.”

The Cash Money chain represents more than luxury — it’s tied to the legacy, relationships, and history behind one of hip-hop’s most influential eras. For Drake, some things simply aren’t commodities. They’re heirlooms.

Is the pendant really a staple in hiphop?
